name: RPA Challenge (Robotic Process Automation)
description: This workflow verifies that your scripts are run correctly and that they cover the required functionality.

tests.name: Run tasks and extract traces
tests.description: Run the Playwright tests and extract traces for further analysis. Passing this step does not guarantee that your tests covered the required functionality, which is checked by the subsequent checks.

tests.name: Access the legacy cars table
tests.description: Checks that your scripts accessed the legacy website and logged in successfully.

tests.name: Open details of a car
tests.description: Checks that your scripts opened the details of a car.

tests.name: Switch to usage tab on car details
tests.description: Checks that your scripts switched to the usage tab on the car details page.

tests.name: Access the target system
tests.description: Checks that your scripts accessed the target system.

tests.name: Add a single car successfully
tests.description: Checks that your scripts added at least a single car successfully.

tests.name: Add the rest of the cars successfully
tests.description: Checks that your scripts added the rest of the cars successfully.
